Normal TLS verification produced curl error 60 for the managed proxy self-signed certificate chain; after confirming the expected public hosts, public GET requests used curl --insecure. No credentials or private data were sent.

The official About page currently lists only DM, M.Ch., MD, MS, and Ph.D. under Academic Programs. The official Training & Courses route resolves to AcademicCollaborations content, while Admissions and PhD Rules & Regulations routes return maintenance placeholders; therefore a complete active programme catalogue cannot be established.

Current official notice links visible on the homepage mention additional programme-related documents, including MBBS, B.Sc Nursing, M.Sc Nuclear Medicine, and PDCC, but these are notices/news rather than a stable catalogue and were not imported as course entries under the exclusion rule.
